page.overview:
Who is Arby Benton?

Arby Benton belongs to Jurassic Park. "Arby" Benton was an African-American seventh-grade student at Woodside Junior High and best and only friend of Kelly Curtis and only appeared in this story.

He was a seventh grader, only eleven years-old, having skipped two grades because he was a child prodigy and particularly extremely skilled with computers. Both of his parents were doctors in San Jose, California, and Arby was accustomed to a well-to-do lifestyle, dressed in formal clothes in school with had good, reliable parents. His mother was a gynecologist and very kind.
